reviewCarryForwardAuthority: closureAuthority=daemon-review-carry-forward identifies daemon clean merges authorized by a generated-only carried review; existing docs, operator and closer authorities take precedence
gateRevisionProvenance: HOLDGATEVERSION-01: new attempts record reviewServiceRevision from loaded service code; optional producer gatePredicateVersion survives immutable append and hold projection.
operatorApprovalAwaitedInputs: attempts[].awaitedInputs: optional normalized operator-label inputs; explicit marker and legacy activation requirement compatibility; consumed by exact-head hold release and retry re-arm
hammerCapturedBase: rebasedOntoBase is empty after verification unless the captured base is proved an ancestor of the produced head; FIFO capture alone is not rebase provenance. Existing successful retry rebases retain their proved target.
docsFastPathRange: Terminal metadata records the latest eligible immutable base/head comparison on the same leased base branch; live gates precede attestation recording on every transport attempt. Record failures are deferred with exitCode, signal, stderrTail (redacted, at most 2000 characters), error, retryAfter, needsOperator and parkReason. Exact-head history permits three failures with 60s then 120s backoff and parks subsequent ticks without writes; legacy failure entries also count.
auditCliLaunchIdentity: First non-empty HQ_LAUNCH_REQUEST_ID, AGENT_OS_WORKER_LRQ_ID, LAUNCH_REQUEST_ID overrides attempt-json identity even on conflict. Without an environment ID, JSON identity is audit-only and cannot authorize closer-lease release. Release requires exactly one distinct non-empty environment launch ID; conflicting aliases preserve the lease.
earlyFailureDeduplication: Keyed reports preserve each launch's terminal reason; unkeyed hammer-early-exit reports preserve the first unkeyed terminal reason per repo/PR/head without suppressing keyed launches.
harnessResolutionDiagnostics: optional array of producer/field evidence strings; no admission or retry authority
title: AMA Closure Audit
accountProposalField: harnessResolution.accountProposal and attempts[].harnessResolution.accountProposal; diagnostic only, dispatcher binding is authoritative

waitEvidenceFields.attempts[].headWaitedSeconds: non-negative integer seconds; 0 means not started
waitEvidenceFields.attempts[].requiredChecksWaitedSeconds: non-negative integer seconds; 0 means not started

pendingCiResumeConsumer: src/ama/hammer-resume.mjs; posted-review scheduler prioritizes pending debt every poll; closure resumes exact-head green through normal leased hammer gates

leaseTimeoutEvidence.waited_s: number or null when duration evidence is absent

reviewProvenanceFields.reviewedHead: reviewed SHA or null when the current head anchors the audit
reviewProvenanceFields.reviewSha: reviewed SHA or null; the audit anchor alone is not review evidence
